description: Three individually sourced highlights for the Phase 2 June composition. This is not the complete event catalog.

juneHighlights.title: Nintendo 64 arrives in Japan
juneHighlights.label: JUN 23, 1996 · JAPAN
juneHighlights.description: A new console, an analog stick, and a leap into three-dimensional play. The U.S. launch follows in September.

juneHighlights.title: Metallica turns the page with Load
juneHighlights.label: JUN 4, 1996 · U.S. RELEASE
juneHighlights.description: Metallica’s sixth studio album takes the band into a new chapter. Open the official discography.

juneHighlights.title: Quake opens the Slipgate
juneHighlights.label: JUN 22, 1996 · PC
juneHighlights.description: id Software’s shooter brings a new kind of 3D world to the PC. Revisit the publisher’s anniversary retrospective.
